mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base_vector_task SET status = 'PROCESSING', lock_owner = #{claimToken}, locked_at = NOW(), started_at = NOW(), finished_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE knowledge_base_vector_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', lock_owner = NULL, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_owner = #{claimToken}

UPDATE knowledge_base_vector_task SET status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, finished_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, started_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count THEN started_at ELSE NULL END, retry_count = retry_count + 1, lock_owner = NULL, locked_at = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_owner = #{claimToken}

UPDATE knowledge_base_vector_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, lock_owner = NULL, locked_at = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), error_message = 'task timeout, reset to pending' WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) AND retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count

UPDATE knowledge_base_vector_task SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, lock_owner = NULL, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), error_message = 'task timeout and max retry reached' WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) AND retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count
